description: NaNiBO₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.65 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.64 Å. There are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.12 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.12 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two Ni, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two Ni, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Ni, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Ni, and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Ni, and one B atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Ni, and one B atom.
